units.source_text: 匂兵部卿亲王也屡次遣使送信来吊慰。

en.t: Prince Niou, the Hyobukyo prince, also sent messengers several times with letters of condolence.

units.source_text: 但两女公子哪有心情答复此种来信！

en.t: But how could the two princesses have any heart to answer such letters!

units.source_text: 匂亲王收不到回信，想道：“她们对薰中纳言并不如此冷淡。

en.t: When Prince Niou received no reply, he thought, "They are not this cold toward Counselor Kaoru.

units.source_text: 这明明是疏远我了。”心中不免怨恨。

en.t: This is plainly their way of keeping me at a distance." He could not help feeling resentful.

units.source_text: 他原拟在红叶茂盛之时赴宇治游玩，乘兴赋诗。

en.t: He had originally planned to go to Uji when the autumn leaves were at their height, enjoy himself, and compose poems.

units.source_text: 今因八亲王逝世，未便来此附近逍遥取乐，

en.t: But now, because the Eighth Prince had passed away, it would not be proper to come near there and wander about for pleasure,

units.source_text: 只得打消此念，心中甚觉扫兴。

en.t: so he had no choice but to give up the idea, and he felt very disappointed.
The forty-ninth day memorial period for the Eighth Prince had passed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想道：“凡事总有限度。

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "There is a limit to everything.

units.source_text: 两女公子的悲哀，现在想必淡然了吧。”

en.t: By now the two princesses' grief must surely have faded somewhat."

units.source_text: 便写了一封长信送去，这正是秋雨霏霏的傍晚，信中有云：

en.t: So he wrote and sent a long letter. It was an evening of steady autumn rain, and in the letter he wrote:
